seoTitle: About SAMUHIA — A Kenyan Technology Company
description: SAMUHIA is a Kenyan technology company founded in 2023, building practical digital products for businesses, institutions, communities and individuals.
title: Building practical technology from Kenya.
lead: SAMUHIA is a Kenyan technology company founded in 2023, building practical digital products that help businesses, institutions, communities and individuals operate, transact and grow more effectively.
mission: To build accessible, practical and dependable technology that simplifies how people, businesses and institutions operate, connect and grow.
vision: To build a connected technology ecosystem that enables businesses and communities across Africa and beyond to participate more effectively in the digital economy.

principles.title: Build for Reality
principles.text: Technology should solve actual problems, not theoretical ones.

principles.title: Simplicity Matters
principles.text: Complex systems should produce simple experiences.

principles.title: Trust by Design
principles.text: Security, reliability and responsible data handling from the beginning.

principles.title: Continuous Improvement
principles.text: Products evolve through usage, feedback and learning.

principles.title: Think Beyond Borders
principles.text: Build from Kenya while designing for a wider world.

footnote: Technology built within the broader Cogvana ecosystem.
